props.title: Three rules that keep claims moving

narration.text: Three rules keep your claim moving. ^ Keep a receipt for anything over twenty-five dollars. ^ Submit within thirty days. ^ And remember, after ninety days, a claim isn't paid at all.

claims.text: A receipt is required for every expense over $25.
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date.
Claims older than 90 days are not reimbursed.
